title: Team customer access
description: Agents can find and link customers during a call only in customer groups their team has access to. Having a customer group grants no access by itself.

permissionHint.WORK: Find, link, and edit customer name/company during a call
permissionHint.VIEW: Show the customer name in dphone embedded in other systems; no customer work

empty: No team has access yet. Agents won't find customers during calls.
noTeams: No active teams yet. Create a team in organization settings first.
duplicate: This team already has this access to this customer group
granted: Access granted. Agents in the team will see customers within a few seconds.
revokeBody: Agents in this team will no longer find or see customers in this group. You can grant it again later.

errors.teams: Couldn't load teams. The table shows team IDs instead of names.
errors.access: This account can't manage team access. Contact your organization's administrator.
errors.session: Your session expired. Sign in again to continue.
